class.name: AudioBusListSettings
class.brief_description: Settings resource of [AudioBusSettingsServer]: the values of the player buses. In [code]res://[/code] also a preset.
class.description: The data of the settings domain [code]"audio_bus"[/code]: one [AudioBusSettings] per player bus (see [member AudioBusSettingsServer.player_buses]). [AudioBusSettingsServer] keeps three copies of it (defaults, applied and pending values, see [method SettingsServer.get_settings]); use the methods of [AudioBusSettingsServer] and [ListSettingsServer] to change the entries. The defaults always come from the project's bus layout. Saved as a [code].tres[/code] file in [code]res://[/code], it is a preset for [method AudioBusSettingsServer.apply_preset], for example a "Night mode" with quieter effects. Buses that a preset does not list keep their values. In the Inspector, the resource shows a small mixer instead of the [member buses] array: one row per player bus of the project's bus layout ([member ProjectSettings.audio/buses/default_bus_layout], only "Master" if there is none) with a checkbox that lists the bus in the resource, a volume slider in decibels and the Mute and Solo checkboxes. Only the values that the project stores ([code]settings/audio_bus/store_*[/code]) are shown; bus names can't be typed freely.

members.member: The entries, one per bus, identified by [member AudioBusSettings.bus_name].
